existing.description: The Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship is a merit award for international students commencing an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at Adelaide University, offering a 50% tuition fee reduction over the standard full-time duration of the degree. Places are limited and allocated on merit by a selection panel reviewing applications on a rolling basis through the recruitment cycle. Applicants must be international students applying to a CRICOS-registered bachelor or master degree that is not on the Excluded Programs list, and must have an ATAR of 99 or an overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale as the basis of admission. Recipients must maintain a minimum Program Term GPA of 5.5 on a 7.0 scale in each compulsory Study Period.
eligibility: Be applying to study a CRICOS registered bachelor degree (minimum 96 units / 2 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL at Adelaide University
Be applying to study a CRICOS registered master degree (minimum 72 units / 1.5 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL at Adelaide University
Undergraduate only: minimum ATAR of 99 (or international equivalent)
Undergraduate and postgraduate: minimum overall Grade Point Average of 6.7 (on a 7.0 scale) or comparable score in the qualification used as the basis of admission
Not be applying to study one of the Excluded Programs
Not be an Australia Awards recipient
Not be an International Sponsored Student entitled to a tuition fee waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value
existing.eligibility_summary: International students applying to a CRICOS-registered bachelor degree (minimum 96 units / 2 years equivalent) or master degree (minimum 72 units / 1.5 years equivalent) at Adelaide University after the application of credit or RPL, with a minimum ATAR of 99 (or international equivalent) for undergraduate entry or a minimum overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale or comparable score for undergraduate and postgraduate entry, who are not applying to an Excluded Program, are not Australia Awards recipients, and are not International Sponsored Students entitled to a fee waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value.
benefits: Applied to the Offer of Admission for the whole standard full-time duration of the eligible degree
coverage: 50% of tuition fees for the standard full-time duration of the degree
requirements: Must maintain a minimum Program Term GPA of 5.5 on a 7.0 scale in each compulsory Study Period
A student cannot receive both this scholarship and a sponsor tuition fee waiver concurrently
documents: Completed Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form
Completed degree application submitted with the scholarship form
Undergraduate applicants: evidence of an ATAR of 99 or international equivalent, or of an overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale in the qualification used as the basis of admission
application_method: Complete the appropriate Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form
Submit the completed form together with the degree application, through an Adelaide University Education Agent or directly via the Online Application System
SATAC applicants use the dedicated SATAC version of the application form
existing.selection_notes: Applications are assessed by a selection panel on merit, reviewed on a rolling basis with offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations are exhausted. Successful recipients are notified prior to commencement and the scholarship is applied to the Offer of Admission.
existing.duration: Standard full-time duration of the recipient's undergraduate or postgraduate Coursework Program
existing.application_period: Applications open from Monday 24 August 2026 and are considered on a rolling basis during the recruitment cycle until allocations are exhausted.
